name: Transporter confirmation (add to notification)
pageTitle: Create transporter confirmation - Import and export applications - GOV.UK
heading: The transporter has been created

govukComponents.usage: Green confirmation panel announcing that the transporter has been created. H1 is rendered as govuk-panel__title (there is no separate govuk-heading-xl).
govukComponents.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84, action 124. QA locator: page-objects/notification/TransporterConfirmationPage.ts:6-8. The CHED-P workflow clicks this action immediately after creating the transporter and then returns to the Transporter page: workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:509-517.

govukComponents.usage: Primary submit button 'Add to notification' (id=button-add, type=submit, value='Add to notification', data-prevent-double-click='true') — attaches the newly-created transporter to the CHED-P notification and navigates to the transport page.
Secondary text link 'Return to search' (id=manage-notifications) linking to .../traders/transporter/search — returns to the transporter search without adding this one to the notification.

fields.name: crumb
fields.label: (hidden CSRF token)
fields.requiredEvidence: CSRF infrastructure field rendered by the shared confirmation template; the confirmation POST handler performs no page-level Joi validation and does not read crumb as a domain value (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/traders/confirmation.html:42-45; service/src/routes/handlers/importer/economic_operator/confirmation.js:52-66).
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84, action 124 — <input name="crumb" type="hidden">; hapi crumb CSRF protection, infrastructure not a user requirement

fields.name: etag
fields.label: (hidden optimistic-concurrency token)
fields.requiredEvidence: Operationally required for the patch that attaches the selected transporter: the template submits etag (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/traders/confirmation.html:42-45), and the POST delegates to selectTheTrader, which passes the payload to patchUtils.doPatchOperations (service/src/routes/handlers/importer/economic_operator/confirmation.js:52-66; service/src/utils/economic_operator.js:95-111). There is no page-level Joi rule or user-facing validation copy on this interstitial.
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84, action 124 — <input name="etag" type="hidden" value="\"0000000000BD28CE\"">; version/etag for optimistic concurrency, infrastructure not a user requirement

fields.name: fromImporterReview
fields.label: (hidden return-context flag)
fields.requiredEvidence: Optional navigation context. The template renders it only when actionsModel.fromImporterReview is set, and the POST handler can also derive the same flag from the query string (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/traders/confirmation.html:45-47; service/src/routes/handlers/importer/economic_operator/confirmation.js:57-59).
fields.conditionalOn: The transporter was created or updated from importer review.

validationMessages.trigger: Attaching the newly created transporter fails, for example because the hidden concurrency token is stale
validationMessages.evidence: No trace or scoped CHED-P QA test captures a failed attach. The page object exposes only the successful 'Add to notification' action (page-objects/notification/TransporterConfirmationPage.ts:3-8), and the workflow always follows the successful path (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:509-517).

openQuestions: Authorised legacy source confirms there is no page-level validation schema or validation-message copy for this confirmation interstitial; POST immediately injects the transporter id and performs the notification patch (economic_operator/confirmation.js:52-66; economic_operator.js:95-111). Stale-etag and attach failures therefore remain integration-error behaviour rather than field validation that can be specified from this page.

This is a confirmation interstitial, not a data-entry page: no user-facing form fields, no caption, no back link. The only two form inputs are hidden infrastructure tokens (crumb = hapi CSRF, etag = optimistic concurrency).

In the new app this whole interstitial may be unnecessary — a created transporter could be attached to the notification in one step without a separate confirmation panel + 'Add to notification' click. Flag as a candidate for simplification rather than a hard requirement.

Only one action is covered by QA: 'Add to notification' (page-objects/notification/TransporterConfirmationPage.ts:6-8; workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:513-517). 'Return to search', panel text, duplicate submission and stale-etag/failure behaviour are not asserted. The page has no editable user inputs, so ordinary field validation is not expected; failed-attach copy remains a gap.
